title: LinkedIn · personal
description: Your selected banner, preserved exactly. Lower-left stays clear for the profile photo.

title: LinkedIn · company Page
description: A wider, shallower layout for the company Page. Main message and cards move inward from the edges.
spec: Current Page recommendation 4200 × 700; PNG or JPEG; maximum 3 MB.

title: YouTube · channel
description: Upload the full image. Logo, headline, subline, and cards sit inside a centered 1540 × 420 area; preview the narrow crop below.
spec: Recommended 2560 × 1440; minimum 2048 × 1152; text/logo safe area 1235 × 338 at minimum size; maximum 6 MB.

title: X · header
description: A deeper blue field, with the headline away from the lower-left avatar and the top/bottom crop zones.
spec: Recommended 1500 × 500. Up to 60 px at the top and bottom can crop.

title: Bluesky · header
description: A deeper blue field, with the headline away from the lower-left avatar and the top/bottom crop zones.
spec: Official app uses a 3:1 crop. 1500 × 500 is our export choice, not a published mandatory pixel size.

title: Mastodon · header
description: A deeper blue field, with the headline away from the lower-left avatar and the top/bottom crop zones.
spec: Headers are downscaled to 1500 × 500; maximum 2 MB. Instance rules can vary.

title: Facebook · cover
description: A 2× export of the 851 × 315 cover canvas. Important content is concentrated in the middle; use Facebook’s final repositioning preview.
spec: 851 × 315 guidance corroborated by a secondary source; Meta help was login-gated during research. Exported at 1702 × 630.

title: Twitch · profile banner
description: Left-weighted typography follows Twitch’s guidance. Channel UI and browser width can change how much of the banner is visible.
spec: Recommended 1200 × 480; graphics concentrated on the left.

title: Pinterest · business cover
description: A spacious landscape composition with the same card details and blue sweep.
spec: Business profile cover: minimum 800 × 450, recommended 16:9. Our export is 1600 × 900.

title: Tumblr · header
description: A spacious landscape composition with the same card details and blue sweep.

title: Reddit · community desktop
description: Community artwork, not a personal profile header. The shallow format uses one headline line and a compact card group.
spec: Desktop minimum 1072 × 128; mobile minimum 1080 × 128. These exports are 2× the respective minimums.

title: Reddit · community mobile
description: Community artwork, not a personal profile header. The shallow format uses one headline line and a compact card group.
spec: Desktop minimum 1072 × 128; mobile minimum 1080 × 128. These exports are 2× the respective minimums.

title: Discord · profile banner
description: Keeps the lower-left clear for the avatar. Requires a Nitro account with profile banner access.

title: Discord · server banner
description: Art-only: blue sweep and report/catalog/review illustrations. No text or logo; the top remains quiet for the server name.
spec: Minimum 960 × 540, 16:9. Keep top 48 px clear; avoid logos and text. Requires an eligible boosted or partnered server.

title: SoundCloud · header
description: Art-only, following SoundCloud’s recommendation to avoid text in headers. The music-business illustrations carry the brand.
spec: At least 2480 × 520; JPG or PNG; maximum 2 MB.

title: Instagram / Threads · portrait post
description: Companion post artwork in a chosen 4:5 canvas. This is not a profile banner.
spec: Chosen 1080 × 1350 post canvas; not a profile-header specification.

title: TikTok / Reels · vertical cover
description: Companion video-cover artwork in a chosen 9:16 canvas. Keep the final app’s captions and controls in mind when positioning.
spec: Chosen 1080 × 1920 video-cover canvas; not a profile-header specification.
